exchanges.text: We have agreed to use Redis for the session cache.
Bob: I will configure the session cache monitoring.
We decided that all invoice exports will be CSV files.
Carol: I will write the invoice export guide.
The team has decided to use Grafana for service dashboards.
Dave: I will build the service health dashboard.
We agreed that the support rota will rotate weekly.
Alice: I will publish the support rota.
We have decided to require two reviewers for security changes.
Bob: I will update the security review checklist.
